propositions: scc LOC adapter (scc_loc.py) invokes scc via deterministic subprocess shell-out with --format json and parses the result into AnalyzerResult.loc payload with per-file LOC keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths and max_loc tracking
the parser must flatten two-level scc JSON (data list -> language groups -> Files array with Code/Location entries) and normalize file paths via PurePath.as_posix() relative to repo_root
scc unavailability (missing binary, non-zero exit, empty/unparseable stdout) returns Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) with warning log and never fabricates zeros
successful empty output (empty files dict and max_loc=0) is valid AnalyzerResult, not Unavailable
scc_loc.analyze() accepts injectable run parameter for testability without requiring live scc binary
